suppress.notes: Added 2026-10-22, re-check by 2027-01-22. CVE-2025-7962 is an SMTP injection in Jakarta Mail (angus-mail, fixed in 2.0.2). It was matched to angus-activation 2.0.3 through a low-confidence CPE (eclipse:angus_mail). angus-activation has no mail code and we send no email. No angus-activation release carries a fix because the artifact is not affected.
